  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY 1
)
SELECT 
  to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_label,
  gross_revenue,
  gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_change
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY mom_change DESC NULLS LAST

WITH january_users AS (
    SELECT id, created_at
    FROM public.users
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT u.id AS user_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS non_cancelled_orders
    FROM january_users u
    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at
      AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
    GROUP BY u.id
)
SELECT ROUND(
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE uo.non_cancelled_orders >= 2)::double precision
     / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric,
    6
) AS share
FROM january_users u
LEFT JOIN user_orders uo ON uo.user_id = u.id

SELECT u.traffic_source, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS user_count,
       ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue_per_user
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id 
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
    AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
  AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY u.traffic_source
ORDER BY gross_revenue_per_user DESC

WITH facebook_users AS (
  SELECT id FROM public.users 
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook' 
  AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
  AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    oi.created_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY oi.created_at) AS order_seq
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN facebook_users fu ON fu.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
)
SELECT 
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (second_order_date - first_order_date)) AS median_days
FROM (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN order_seq = 1 THEN created_at::date END) AS first_order_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN order_seq = 2 THEN created_at::date END) AS second_order_date
  FROM user_orders
  WHERE order_seq <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
) t

WITH user_data AS (
  SELECT 
    u.id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
    u.created_at AS reg_time,
    MIN(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.created_at END) AS first_non_cancelled_order_time
  FROM public.users u
  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
  WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY u.id, u.created_at
)
SELECT 
  TO_CHAR(acquisition_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_non_cancelled_order_time IS NOT NULL 
                      AND first_non_cancelled_order_time >= reg_time 
                      AND first_non_cancelled_order_time < reg_time + INTERVAL '30 days')
    )::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4
  ) AS share
FROM user_data
GROUP BY acquisition_month
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH user_spend AS (
  SELECT oi.user_id, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS gross_spend
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id
)
SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend))::numeric, 2) AS p90_gross_spend
FROM user_spend

WITH organic_users AS (
    SELECT id 
    FROM public.users 
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Organic' 
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN organic_users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ordered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS order_rank
    FROM user_orders
),
first_two AS (
    SELECT 
        o1.user_id,
        o1.order_date AS first_order_date,
        o2.order_date AS second_order_date,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM o2.order_date - o1.order_date) AS days_between
    FROM ordered_orders o1
    JOIN ordered_orders o2 ON o1.user_id = o2.user_id AND o2.order_rank = 2
    WHERE o1.order_rank = 1
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days
FROM first_two

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        user_id,
        SUM(sale_price) AS order_value,
        MIN(created_at) AS order_created_at
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
user_first_order AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MIN(order_created_at) AS first_order_time
    FROM order_values
    GROUP BY user_id
),
order_classification AS (
    SELECT 
        ov.order_id,
        ov.user_id,
        ov.order_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN ov.order_created_at = ufo.first_order_time THEN 'first'
            ELSE 'repeat'
        END AS order_type
    FROM order_values ov
    JOIN user_first_order ufo ON ufo.user_id = ov.user_id
)
SELECT 
    order_type,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS median_order_value
FROM order_classification
GROUP BY order_type
ORDER BY order_type

WITH order_times AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_id, MIN(created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS order_seq
    FROM order_times
),
first_two AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN order_seq = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order_time,
           MAX(CASE WHEN order_seq = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order_time
    FROM user_orders
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
day_diffs AS (
    SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order_time - first_order_time)) / 86400 AS days_between
    FROM first_two
)
SELECT ROUND((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between))::numeric, 2) AS p95_days
FROM day_diffs

WITH search_users AS (
  SELECT id FROM public.users 
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Search' 
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN search_users su ON su.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_id,
    order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
  FROM user_orders
),
first_second AS (
  SELECT 
    r1.user_id,
    r1.order_date AS first_order_date,
    r2.order_date AS second_order_date,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r2.order_date - r1.order_date)) / 86400 AS days_diff
  FROM ranked_orders r1
  JOIN ranked_orders r2 ON r1.user_id = r2.user_id AND r1.rn = 1 AND r2.rn = 2
)
SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff))::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM first_second
